retainedDecisions: No public API, product dependency, cryptographic algorithm, entropy source, nonce domain, failure budget or protocol authentication check was relaxed.
No shorter sleep, larger queue, changed frame geometry or changed media pacing is counted as an optimization.
No MLS crypto/encoding redesign or extra actor/copy optimization was introduced without supporting profiles.
Existing workload identities remain intact; all 31 expanded workloads use version-four identities and explicit endpoints.

integrity.populationChecks: Retained analyzers verify full raw/enriched report, receipt, fixture, schedule and histogram populations; index rechecks hashes, complete process statuses and joined cleanup.

limitations: Informational local fresh-process observations on an uncontrolled host; no numerical acceptance gate.
Each reported mean is one process's exact timed sum divided by completed wrapper calls.
Batch quantile bounds describe complete per-process batch populations; process populations are never pooled.
Wrapper calls have different policy-specific populations; endpoint percentiles are not additive.
Process CPU includes population setup/oracles/cleanup; lifetime peak RSS includes startup and warmup.
Optional allocator gauges describe their explicit owner/time scope and are not cumulative allocation events.
